run_GAN_training: run a GAN training job for PGAN, StyleGAN, or DCGAN models with a config file
run_training_with_checkpoint: resume GAN training from an existing checkpoint in the output directory
run_training_no_visualization: run GAN training with all visualizations disabled for headless environments
run_training_numpy_visualizer: run GAN training using a numpy-based visualizer for SLURM cluster environments
review_getTrainer: review the getTrainer function that dynamically loads PGAN, StyleGAN, or DCGAN trainer modules
